title: Gluing constructibility of $f^!K$ and restricting the adjunction
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$, a field $k$ of characteristic $p>0$ with $p\ne\ell$, and a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ inside a fixed algebraic closure $\Qlb=\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$. Let $X,Y$ be separated schemes of finite type over $k$ and $f:X\to Y$ a separated finite-type $k$-morphism, in the standing setting [sk-def-sfb-dc-setting]. Let $\Lambda=E$ or $\Qlb$. For $E$, use the condensed ring $S\mapsto C(S,E)$ on profinite sets, with the $\ell$-adic topology [sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring]. For $\Qlb$, use [sk-def-sfb-qlbar-condensed]: its sections on a profinite set $S$ are the continuous maps $S\to\Qlb$ whose image is contained in some finite subextension of $\mathbf Q_\ell$. Pull these rings back to the scheme pro-étale topoi [sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients] and use their module-object coefficients. Use $D(X_{\mathrm{proét}},\Lambda)$ and $\Dbc(X,\Lambda)$ as in [sk-def-sfb-constructible], the full localizing closures of [sk-def-localizing-closure], and the compact-support functor $Rf_!$ with right adjoint $f^!$ supplied by [sk-prop-sf-existence].

1. Let $M\in D(X_{\mathrm{proét}},\Lambda)$ and let $X=\bigcup_{\alpha\in I}U_\alpha$ be a finite open cover with $M|_{U_\alpha}\in\Dbc(U_\alpha,\Lambda)$ for all $\alpha\in I$. Then $M\in\Dbc(X,\Lambda)$.
2. For $K\in\Dbc(Y,\Lambda)$, $f^!K\in\Dbc(X,\Lambda)$, and for $A\in\Dbc(X,\Lambda)$ the adjunction bijection restricts naturally to
$$
\Hom_{\Dbc(Y,\Lambda)}(Rf_!A,K)\simeq\Hom_{\Dbc(X,\Lambda)}(A,f^!K).
$$

proof.text: The standing finite-type schemes are Noetherian by locallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian and compactSpace_of_compactSpace. Apply localizingClosure_ctf_equals_bc for the specified rational coefficient, transported by the given monoid-object isomorphism. This gives Dctf=Dbc and hence the inclusion of Dbc in its localizing closure. The finite-subextension-valued Qbar coefficient is retained.

Forget module objects to their underlying abelian sheaves. upperStarObjXIso identifies the forgetful image of each coefficient restriction with the abelian-sheaf inverse image. The finite jointly-surjective quasi-compact pullback detection theorem makes a module with zero restrictions zero. Apply this to each cohomology module using the exact-functor homology comparison. The finite ranges of local lower and upper bounds have common bounds, also for an empty index type; these give global boundedness.

For each cohomology module apply the affine-local clause of finiteConstantStratified_zariski_locality. Pull the finite given open cover back to each affine open W. Pull back each local finite stratification and its unchanged finite constant scalar models along the morphism restricting W into the given open; the inverse-image composition comparison identifies this with restriction along the composite into X. The finite-cover assembly clause yields constructibility on W, and the affine-local criterion gives global constructibility. Exact restriction identifies the local cohomology modules with cohomology of the restricted complexes. Combine with the boundedness just proved; empty covers and schemes are included.

Apply restrictionLocal to the supplied compactification and adjunction. Its finite affine chart family covers X. Give each chart and affine target its inherited finite-type-over-k structure. The chosen boundary compactifications and exists_localizingExceptionalAdjoint supply the projection and closed-immersion adjunctions required by its local clause. Thus the restriction of G(K) to each chart is bounded constructible. Replace each chart by its isomorphic opensRange: pull back its stratification and unchanged finite constant local models along the inverse isomorphism, and use exact derived inverse-image composition and cohomology comparisons. Apply the finite-cover assertion just proved.

The final clause of compactification_localizing preserves Dctf along the given boundary compactification. The Dctf=Dbc equality from step 1 therefore supplies the required Dbc preservation of its actual compact-support composite.

Use the two full inclusion functors induced by the Dbc-to-localizing-closure inclusions. Both squares with the concrete restricted functors commute definitionally. Apply Adjunction.restrictFullyFaithful to the supplied adjunction. Its homEquiv formula, with identity comparison isomorphisms, gives exactly the original homEquiv after forgetting membership proofs, as required.

proof_origin.place: Paragraphs (1)–(2); B2 Lean proof using proved constant-model Zariski locality, finite-cover zero detection, chart isomorphism transport, and fully faithful adjunction restriction.

The item statement adds the standing setting of sk-def-sfb-dc-setting, which sk-prop-sf-existence needs for f^! to exist. The worker's counterexample (an infinite disjoint union of Spec k) shows why that setting is needed. Both conclusions are kept and nothing is weakened. Step checks: step 1 uses 01T6 and 01K4 for Noetherian X and Y, and the heart node for Dctf=Dbc. Step 2 uses exact module pullback from sk-prop-sfb-cartesian-coefficients, and the zero check is done on the open cover T×_X U_α. Step 3 builds strata of X with immersion composition (e) and reduced complements (2), takes a common refinement by clause (1), and restricts lisse sheaves by clause (2). Each nonempty stratum lies in some U_α. Step 4 uses det-thm-restriction-local (finite chart cover plus local Dbc) and then clause (1). Step 5 uses the same Rp_*∘j_! as sk-prop-sf-existence and det-sf-comp-coherence-single with Y qcqs. Step 6 is elementary because the subcategories are full. No cycle; proof_deps equals the union of the uses. No new nodes and no duplicates (det-thm-int-restriction-glue is the O_E analogue). I accept all four declared tool_uses. No SGA source. FIX, three repairs: (1) Step 1 now states the Qlb coefficient explicitly as the finite-subextension ring, which matches the master and the heart and local nodes. It differs from C(-,Qlb): x_n=ℓ^{n+1/n}→0 gives a continuous map whose image lies in no finite subextension. Before this, the item silently applied sk-def-localizing-closure and det-sf-comp-coherence-single, whose DAG wording ('ℓ-adic topology') literally gives C(-,Qlb). This is a pre-existing imprecision in those reviewed nodes, outside this delivery, reported to the maintainer: they should cite sk-def-sfb-qlbar-condensed. (2) Step 3 now takes constructibility from the heart node's lisse characterization, not from sk-def-sfb-constructible's local-model definition.
